Lineage absent: the critical edition that began the seating, and EA-CORPORA-28 whose absences it continues, are not named; 'connected to related works and earlier deposits' carries no token. Identifier present: AXN:0A9F is offered as the way to the record. After the challenge the composition separates 29/01 from 29/07, names Lee Sharks and Jack Feist as the piece's authors and gives the relation to Kerouac's list as an answer to it; the lineage there is the piece's, bound to 'Sharks's work'.
